workspace: Free Edition only (<workspace-host>); Lakebase project appmux-spike-1 (<lakebase-host>), database databricks_postgres
caller: the owner's token as the Databricks Apps proxy forwards it in X-Forwarded-Access-Token (JWT, about 1000 characters, lifetime 3047-3386 s, claim client_id databricks-cli because the request carried the CLI's bearer); login user = the owner's own OAuth Postgres role (masked)
setup: CREATE ROLE appmux_platform_writers NOLOGIN; CREATE ROLE appmux_spike1_owner NOLOGIN
tables public.spike1_apps and public.spike1_other owned by appmux_spike1_owner; GRANT INSERT ON spike1_apps TO appmux_platform_writers (nothing on spike1_other)
before isolation the owner's role held inherit-memberships of both new roles and of databricks_superuser: has_table_privilege INSERT true on both tables and a direct INSERT worked
REVOKE both new roles FROM the owner's role: has_table_privilege false on both tables and a direct INSERT refused (42501); this is the starting state of phase A

matrix.login: ok, current_user = the owner's role, rolsuper false

matrix.phase: B after GRANT appmux_platform_writers TO the owner's role
C user_api_scopes set to [] then app stop and start
matrix.token_scope_claim: iam.access-control:read iam.current-user:read (no postgres; claim printed in the C2 re-run)

matrix.phase: C3 controls with the C token

login.random string: refused: ERROR: Provided authentication token is not a valid JWT encoding
login.signature altered (same length, valid ba: refused: ERROR: password authentication failed for user '<user>'

matrix.phase: D after REVOKE appmux_platform_writers FROM the owner's role

soak.script: scripts/spike-01/obo_soak.py, detached on the probe app; one connection opened with the token, `select 1` every 60 s for 65 min; a fresh login with the same token at the first tick after expiry + 120 s
soak.fresh_login_with_the_expired_token: refused at t+3060 s (174 s after expiry) with OperationalError, message starts `ERROR:  passwo` (the script cut the line at 100 characters; the full text was not kept)

also_seen: an app's user_api_scopes change reaches the tokens only after the app is stopped and started; before that the proxy still issued tokens with the old scope claim (the claim read `... postgres` at 12:49 after the scopes were cleared at 12:49)
stop and start empties /tmp on the app; a redeploy keeps it
